newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RGC Q1 mineral sands output mostly up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RGC Q1 mineral sands output mostly up.

text.p: Mining house RGC Ltd said on Thursday that mineral sands output from its wholly-owned operations was mostly higher in the 1996/97 first quarter while tin production from Tasmania fell slightly.

RGC said mineral sands production from Eneabba North in Western Australia was limited by declining high grade ore sources. Ore quality changes resulted in processing difficulties and reduced recoveries, it said.
Mineral sands output from the company's Consolidated Rutile Ltd subsidiary was lower in the latest three months ended September 30.
